acceptanceCriteria: confirmed: verify:task accepts exactly npm audit --omit=dev and executes it as npm with the fixed arguments audit and --omit=dev, without a shell.
confirmed: verify:task rejects npm audit, npm audit fix, npm audit --omit=dev with any extra argument, npm commands with shell operators, and every other npm command as blocked.
confirmed: The verifier preserves the audit process exit code: zero passes; nonzero or execution error fails the required test; unsupported text remains blocked.
confirmed: The verifier self-test covers the exact accepted command, its command and argument mapping, and representative rejected near-miss and mutation-capable forms.
confirmed: Verification policy documents the one admitted audit command and the continued fail-closed behavior.
confirmed: Independent QA records a successful verifier result with changed-path and secret-boundary checks, or records a durable blocked or fail result without weakening the control.
